passages.title: What Lies Beyond the Fog
passages.text:
Dis is de ruins of an Amani town.

It must be what remains of de settlement here before de bridge fell and de island fell prey to de curse.

But if even de loa can't come here, how have these tortollans survived? Why are dey here?

passages.title: What Lies Beyond the Fog
passages.text:
With de loa, we are powerful. Without de loa, we are still the Amani. We will get our kin back.

Liadrin will join us soon with reinforcements, and my warriors are eager to take vengeance.

There can be no delay. For my people's sake and for Zul'jan's.

passages.title: The Glint of History
passages.text:
The goddess answers us! There must be some lesson to learn in this vision.

Let us learn from the past.

passages.title: The Glint of History
passages.text:
The ruins across this island are ancient, built by the Amani long ago. If we discover how they came to be here, we may learn the truth of Ula'tek.

Then we can show Zul'jan what he is really chasing.

I have an idea of where to look for that crypt. Let us go together, <name>.

passages.title: The Glint of History
passages.text: Goddess willing, we will see a memory of the past.

passages.title: Echoed Steps
passages.text:
These must be her remains. She was sealed here and left to die. 

But why?

passages.title: Echoed Steps
passages.text:
Sometimes the goddess' visions are not easy to understand at first, but in time she reveals her intentions.

I will keep the Children of Ula'tek out of your path as you follow her memories.

Trust that she will reveal what we need to learn.

Meet me up ahead once you have witnessed her memories of the Amani.

passages.title: Echoed Steps
passages.text: These memories... What are we meant to learn from them?

passages.title: What Was Buried
passages.text:
I have seen this history before, but something is missing... 

We must search for more.

passages.title: What Was Buried
passages.text:
The visions of Nek'zali led us here. That we found where she took her last breath is no coincidence.

There must be something within this crypt that the goddess wishes for us to see.

Zul'jarra bid us to find the truth of Ula'tek. Perhaps here we will find the answers we seek.

Let us see where the story we were told in the Den of Echoes ends, and where the truth begins.

passages.title: What Was Buried
passages.text: The spirits here are unlike Azeroth's memories. What curse binds them to this place?

passages.title: Lurking in the Dark
passages.text: Whatever the reason they were buried here and whatever reason they have awoken, they deserve to return to the goddess.

passages.title: Lurking in the Dark
passages.text:
Those who built this crypt would not have sealed it without good reason.

A great evil from the past must dwell here.

We should put to rest any spirits and undead we find. They cannot keep us from the answers we seek.

passages.title: Lurking in the Dark
passages.text: This is a potent evil. It rivals even the Black Blood.

passages.title: Written by the Victors
passages.text:
Zul'jarra is... ill?

What has happened in our absence?

passages.title: Written by the Victors
passages.text:
A version of this history is written into the Den of Echoes. The same events, only recorded by Amani hands instead of haranir ones. 

But something is missing: Nek'zali. How is she part of the story of Ula'tek? 

And we do not know how Ula'tek came to this world.

We must go deeper into the crypt and witness the truth written on its walls.

passages.title: Delay the Venom
passages.text: This troll is with you, <name>? If he wishes to fight the many foes standing between us and the answers we seek, I welcome his aid.

passages.title: Delay the Venom
passages.text:
The wound from Zul'jan's blade. It won't heal.

Zul'jan must have poisoned her. She's weakening, and I have not been successful in curing her with Light.

<Liadrin engulfs Zul'jarra in Light again. Nothing changes.>

Blast it!

Whatever you found in that crypt can wait.

The Amani are trying to find a cure. Ask Raz'taka if he's made any progress.

If you need anything else, talk to Tak'lejo. Zul'jarra needs to focus on recovering.

passages.title: Delay the Venom
passages.text: <Orweyna closes her eyes as if listening for something.>

passages.title: Clear the Swamp
passages.text: The beasts are resilient. They must be, to survive in such a place.

passages.title: Clear the Swamp
passages.text:
Look in the distance. Restless, evil energy fills the sky. That structure ahead must have the answers we seek.

The creatures that stand in our way must be culled. We cannot risk being overcome on such a vital mission.

passages.title: Clear the Swamp
passages.text: Thin their numbers. I won't risk us being surrounded.

passages.title: Haunted Shore
passages.text:
The spirits of de swamp possessed de tortollans?

I got more questions than I know what to do with.

passages.title: Haunted Shore
passages.text:
With Zul'jarra down, de Amani are losin' heart with each passin' moment. We gotta do somethin' to show dem that dis isn't over.

Those tortollans have been helpin' where they can. Let's repay de favor and help out de captain. 

Seein' a bunch of their lost crew return to town oughta give dem some hope in dis cursed land.

passages.title: Haunted Shore
passages.text: What is happenin' here?

passages.title: Fuel the Calling
passages.text: Their sacrifice was for de good of the Amani, whether dey knew it or not.

passages.title: Fuel the Calling
passages.text:
<Your loyal follower keeps her voice low as you approach.>

As you foretold, red rain falls from de sky. De heavens align. A great beast rouses at de door beneath de world. At last, a weapon for de Amani--one greater than any Zandalari loa. We just need de fuel to summon it.

Most of de warband is injured and isolated. Fallen soldiers will welcome de sight of you, expecting you to heal dem.

Take your dagger and do what must be done. Only you can save us, Nek'zali.

passages.title: Fuel the Calling
passages.text: <Your loyal follower lowers her head as you approach.>

passages.title: Pushed to the Brink
passages.text:
De armies of de aqir are without end. Dey are all around us.

We fought hard, Nek'zali. But we are out of options.

passages.title: Pushed to the Brink
passages.text:
De ocean at our back slithers with tentacles and eyes, but we are safer there than on dis land. We were fools to think we could claim it from Kith'ix.

I have stood by your new obsession with rituals and superstitions, Nek'zali. Now, I need you to be de healer you once were.

Help my soldiers fight off de aqir. Buy us the time we need for de transport boats to arrive.

passages.title: Pushed to the Brink
passages.text: De promise of an empire was a lie. De Zandalari sent us to our deaths.

passages.title: The Summoning of Ula'tek
passages.text:
De weapon dat saved de Amani. It was a monster created by another monster... to kill a monster!

Dat's what our ancestors built their empire on?

passages.title: The Summoning of Ula'tek
passages.text:
Where is de rest of our warband?! De lines are breaking!

My soldiers will hold dem off as long as dey can. De weak should run. But you and I... if we die, let it be together with weapons in hand, sister.

passages.title: Awakened Evil
passages.text: The Fang of Ula'tek. The dagger that Zul'jan wields. We have to find it.

passages.title: Awakened Evil
passages.text:
Nek'zali, dat priestess... We should bring word of what we've seen back to de hash'ey.

Orweyna. Ay! Wait--what's wrong with her?

passages.title: Site of Terror
passages.text: The goddess is calling out in pain. I have never seen her memories in such a state.

passages.title: Site of Terror
passages.text:
The air is thick with restless spirits. But there's more--it is the goddess. Where her voice was once quiet, I can feel it is now raised in anguish. Like a scream of terror.

I fear for what we may find ahead.

I will follow her voice. Come. Together, we uncover her memories of this place.

passages.title: Site of Terror
passages.text: Let us go before her song fades.

passages.title: Digging Deeper
passages.text: <Kinduru takes the bundle of scrolls. He says nothing, but is clearly concerned.>

passages.title: Digging Deeper
passages.text:
De mask says we are lookin' for de scrolls of Malacrass. While we are in Maisara, try to find any scrolls de Vilebranch have left around.

Maisara is a dangerous place, so don't bother sortin' through dem--just grab 'em and we can check later.

Even if dey don't mention Ula'tek, we might find information about their plans or intentions against de Amani.

passages.title: Digging Deeper
passages.text: Dis search for Ula'tek is becomin' more dangerous than Zul'jan realizes.

passages.title: Mission to Maisara
passages.text: Malacrass is dead, but dat doesn't mean his knowledge is lost.

passages.title: Mission to Maisara
passages.text:
De magic helped, but... not enough. I still don't remember my name or past life. Dat knowledge may be lost forever...

I do remember more about Ula'tek--or rather, where we might find more information!

I was forced into dis form by de Vilebranch trolls. Dey kept dark knowledge secret from de other tribes, includin' knowledge of Ula'tek.

If we are to know more, we must go to de Maisara Deeps.

passages.title: Memories of Malacrass
passages.text: The Maisara Caverns are even more dangerous than de Deeps, and Vordaza is as deadly as she is cruel.

passages.title: Memories of Malacrass
passages.text:
While I was a servant of de Vilebranch, I remember discussions about Malacrass's research into Ula'tek.

Malacrass recorded his knowledge in scrolls that he kept with him. Now that he's dead, we need to find out what happened to dem.

De Vilebranch hex masters won't talk willingly... but if you slay dem, I can use their own necromantic magic against dem to compel dem to speak.

passages.title: Maisara Caverns: Master of Souls
passages.text:
You got dem. Now let's see if dis was worth all de effort.

<Zul'jan flips through the scrolls.>

passages.title: Maisara Caverns: Master of Souls
passages.text:
Malacrass's notes are with Vordaza, and she's using them to further her necromantic experiments.

I need you to go into de Maisara Caverns to recover them. It will be dangerous, and you will need to gather allies before venturing in.

I will stay here and protect my uncle. We need to sort through all de scrolls we gathered and see what else we can find out.

passages.title: Maisara Caverns: Master of Souls
passages.text: Will Malacrass's notes hold de next clue? Or is dis all just a waste of time?

passages.title: The Tablets of Numazon
passages.text: Uncle does not understand. Ula'tek could change everything.

passages.title: The Tablets of Numazon
passages.text:
De ancestors did not bow to a loa--dey claimed a weapon! A weapon dat led to our victory.

I must know more.

You said de tablets at Numazon are de oldest in Zul'Aman. We can continue de search there. Perhaps de ancient Amani left behind clues for us.

Uncle says we should bring de mask. A stray memory might be de key to unlocking dis mystery.

passages.title: There's the Rub
passages.text:
Look here! Dis mentions the Amani summoning a great serpent to save dem from a terrible foe.

And here, de serpent was victorious but de Amani sealed it away.

De first shrine built in Atal'Aman was dedicated to the serpent.

<Kinduru continues to analyze the rubbings.>

passages.title: There's the Rub
passages.text:
If de tablets were made when de Amani first arrived in Zul'Aman, den there must be some clue about Ula'tek here.

De tablets are too heavy to carry, so Uncle suggested dat we take rubbings of de inscriptions.

I scouted ahead and gathered a few, but I ran into de Vilebranch. I came back here to make sure Uncle was safe.

Enter Numazon and collect more of de rubbings while I watch over Uncle. Watch out for de Vilebranch.

passages.title: There's the Rub
passages.text: Let me take a look at the rubbings...

passages.title: Brain Drain
passages.text: It will just take a moment to drain de magic from de fetishes.

passages.title: Brain Drain
passages.text:
I wish I could be more help but... de gaps in my memory. Due to de damage de mask has sustained, dat magic has leaked out for who knows how long.

You repaired de physical parts of de mask, but de magic within is still weak.

Zul'jan says Vilebranch trolls occupy this crypt. De magic dat binds me together is like de magic they use.

You might be able to help. Retrieve their hex fetishes--I should be able to drain the magic from them.

passages.title: Brain Drain
passages.text: De magic of the Vilebranch feels so familiar... Did dey put me in this mask?

passages.text:
Dis shrine is ancient. Small. Unremarkable.

passages.title: The Serpent Shrine
passages.text:
Here! De note says Ula'tek was sealed away by de Amani. To break de seal, one needs a "key."

<Zul'jan flips through the notes.>

De key was hidden within a shrine and protected with ancient magic. But which shrine... 

<Zul'jan looks up.>

Didn't de tablets at Numazon mention a shrine bein' "dedicated to de serpent's victory?" We know from de visions in Harandar dat Ula'tek was a serpent. 

Dat must be it! De key is hidden at de serpent shrine in Atal'Aman!

passages.title: Legacy of the Amani
passages.text: The Amani found you and Kinduru at Atal'Aman. They carried you back here.

passages.title: Legacy of the Amani
passages.text:
If Malacrass was right, de key to Ula'tek should be right here.

<Zul'jan's heavy hammer thumps onto the shrine for emphasis.>

It may take me some time to break through de stone to find it.

I don't know what kind of protection de ancestors have in place, but you will have to deal with dem while I work.

I admit, I did not believe de visions in Harandar. I don't fully trust Malacrass's notes either.

But if de key is here, dat would be undeniable proof dat what we are chasing is real.

passages.title: Dead End
passages.text:
I have already sent scouts to search for Zul'jan, but it will be impossible to cover so much ground. I pray he sees through de lies dat Malacrass has woven before it's too late.

<Zul'jarra's expression is grim, then softens as a small eagle lands on your shoulder.>

Thank you, <name>, for telling me what happened and for being with my uncle at de end.

Dis eagle was my uncle's favorite companion on his walks through Zul'Aman. I think he would like it if you took care of him now dat he's gone.

passages.title: Dead End
passages.text:
After the meeting in Harandar, I came here to speak with Zul'jarra about the vision you witnessed. Zul'jan had seemed upset when you left and it was not my intent to make him so.

But all of that can wait. Now that you're awake, you should go speak to Zul'jarra. She wants to know what happened at Atal'Aman.

passages.title: Dead End
passages.text: How could this have happened?

passages.title: Them That Were Lost
passages.text:
My brother has much to answer for. His path is growin' darker with each step he takes.

Whether he knew about their capture and torture, or was just lettin' it happen, it is clear I need to knock some sense into him.

passages.title: Them That Were Lost
passages.text:
My brother is here. And so are de captives.

Dey are bein' held in de small shrines ahead. For what, I don't know.

But somehow my brother is involved.

Gettin' my people free of dis place is of de highest priority. Do whatever is necessary to free dem.

Zul'jan can wait until de prisoners are safe.

passages.title: Them That Were Lost
passages.text: I will fight for dem until dey are free.

passages.title: Situation Normal, All Snaked Up
passages.text:
<Zul'jarra's eyes are locked on the figure of her brother. 

You expect bright fury to be in her eyes, but all you see is dull sadness.>

passages.title: Situation Normal, All Snaked Up
passages.text:
<Zul'jarra's hand tightens on her axe.>

We knew de island was cursed, but is dis de curse? Or has what Zul'jan and Malacrass done brought dem here?

De answer doesn't matter. We must find and save de ones dey kidnapped--and find my brother.

<Zul'jarra surveys the island stretching out around her. Her eyes narrow.>

I see somethin' ahead. A structure. I'm gonna see if my people are there.

You protect de people here. Crush de serpents. Grind dem into de ground.

Meet me when you are done.

passages.title: Situation Normal, All Snaked Up
passages.text: Nobody's gonna be safe until dey are all dead.

passages.title: Fire, the Only Way to Be Sure
passages.text:
Praise dat Jan'alai found us worthy of our blessin'.

Praise dat de hash'ey's will has been done!

passages.title: Fire, the Only Way to Be Sure
passages.text:
De prisoners need to be rescued, yes, but dis place is an abomination.

We must cleanse it with de spirit-born fire of Jan'alai.

Take dis totem. It will allow you to wield de breath of our loa.

Purge their nests. And kill de spiteful broodsisters that laid dem!

passages.title: Fire, the Only Way to Be Sure
passages.text: Did you fry de eggs and de hens dat laid dem?

passages.title: Death of Furies
passages.text:
That dagger... that power...

What is he doin'?

We have to talk him down.

passages.title: Death of Furies
passages.text:
Now only these creatures block our way to...

<Zul'jarra growls softly.>

...to Zul'jan.

Dey are protectin' him like he's one of dem. One of their army.

Whether he is or not, we gotta take dem down if we're gonna find out.

passages.title: Death of Furies
passages.text: Dey must be dealt with, $m.

Our status as hash'uras aside, <name>, I refuse to stand by and let that happen.

passages.text:
Stay here, hash'ura. I'm goin' in to talk to him.

Maybe I can talk him into leavin' on his own--and tellin' us what Malacrass has planned.

I hope to de loa that he will come to his senses.

passages.title: Butchery Basics

De art of Amani huntin' is about discipline. You practice until de skills come as naturally as breathin'.

But right now, discipline means doin' what I tell you.

<A glowing parchment appears in front of you with the symbol of a home in front of it.>

Greetings, <name>!

Have you ever wanted to own a home? Have a place to call your own? Now you can!

Join us in Founder's Point, the new Housing Neighborhood. Get your very own slice of Azeroth!

passages.title: Broken Spears
passages.text:
So many dead. De foe we faced must have been mighty. 

Yet we conquered it together!

passages.title: Broken Spears
passages.text:
De spirits, their weapons--I recognize dem! Dey are Amani: heroes and warriors from our murals and stories! Dis was de site of a great battle--one dat earned us de right to call dis land Zul'Aman. 

We should bring evidence of our history back to the others watchin' Zul'jarra, to remind 'em we got our ancestors watchin' over us.

Takin' de raised spirits' weapons may "raise some spirits" back at camp, no?

passages.title: Broken Spears
passages.text:
Jokin' aside, what haunts these warriors? 

Shouldn't dey be at rest?

passages.title: Awe of She
passages.text:
The Zandalari sent us to die.

Knowing it changes nothing. We make our stand against de aqir, or we fall.

passages.title: Awe of She
passages.text:
It's the priestess again--the one whose remains we found in the crypt.

These memories--no. Not memories. They are like nightmares. Something horrible befell the goddess. We must see it directly. Hear her song through all the noise.

I fear this vision will be too much for me alone. Join me, both of you, and let us witness the goddess' past terror.

I was sent here to prove dat I am ready to be an Amani warrior. All dat want de honor must prove demselves.

I chose de gnarldin since dey are close now, and I heard Zul'jarra softened dem up a little.

Looks like I wasn't de only one who thought dat and was wrong.

But I still need to collect as many trophies from de gnarldin as possible.

If I have de bigshot hash'ura helpin' me, there's no way I can lose, no?

You get de trophies. I will stay behind to watch our backs.

passages.text: Did you get de trophies? De gnarldin have plenty of dem from all their fightin'.

passages.title: Scavenged Victory
passages.text:
Dis is plenty!

All of dem were actually dead... right?

passages.title: Scavenged Victory
passages.text:
Many warriors have chosen to face de gnarldin since dey came to Zul'Aman, but many have failed.

Dey thought now dat de gnarldin are in our territory and weakened, dey would be easier...

De gnarldin hunters have collected tablets from de Amani hunters dat fell here.

But with you at my side, we can get "vengeance" for those dat lost their lives here--no killin' or life riskin' required.

We don't have to kill de gnarldin. We just have to get close enough to gather de tablets. What do you say?

passages.title: Scavenged Victory

passages.title: Bitter Fury
passages.text:
Hah! Tusk Taker is dead!

De others will see me as a true Amani warrior now--when I tell them I took all de trophies that killed Tusk Taker.

De leader of de gnarldin here is known as Tusk Taker. Take a wild guess why she's named dat.

Defeat her for me, and no one can challenge my right to be an Amani warrior.

passages.title: Calling All Combatants!
passages.text:
<Mirvedon clears his throat.>

Take these heraldries straight over to the Crafting Order station to get a custom piece. Anything you make with these will keep you safe while crossing swords in the battlegrounds. If you ever want more heraldies I've got what you need.

For a price this time, of course.

passages.title: Calling All Combatants!
passages.text:
<You read a nearby advertisement...>

Run, don't walk!

The Artisan's Consortium has teamed up with local Silvermoon artisans in Falconwing Square to offer a new selection of heraldries and crafted equipment. These are certified for use in arenas and battlegrounds, guaranteed!

Head on down and look for Mirvedon to receive your free sample today.

Act now while supplies last! Terms and conditions apply.

-Aisha

passages.title: Shrine Preparations
passages.text:
<Kanza claps and jumps up and down excitedly.

But she pulls at your sleeve and makes an arcing motion with her hand, pointing into the far distance.

There is something else she wants you to do.>

passages.title: Shrine Preparations
passages.text:
<Kanza makes no sound but briefly meets your gaze. She points off toward the hot spring pools.

Maybe she wants you to do something there?>

passages.title: Shrine Preparations
passages.text: <Kanza shifts her weight from foot to foot, swaying impatiently.>

passages.title: Temple and a Teapot
passages.text:
I had to see her.

Just one more time.

passages.title: Temple and a Teapot
passages.text:
<Kanza is dancing with excitement.

She holds her small hand with one finger up.

One last thing to do.

You must almost be ready for the ritual to summon Filo--if that is indeed what she is asking for your help to do.

She fishes in her tunic for something and presents an object to you: the broken handle of a teapot, presumably from the one she dropped on the way here.

Perhaps she needs a substitute?>

passages.title: Temple and a Teapot
passages.text: <Kanza looks nervous and expectant.>

passages.title: Slithering in the Mire
passages.text:
Good work keeping dem busy while I looked for Wa'kani and de others.

You dealt de Children of Ula'tek a blow, but we need to keep de pressure on.

passages.title: Slithering in the Mire
passages.text:
De Children of Ula'tek overwhelmed de swamp and its inhabitants. Dey kill anything in their path, just to increase their numbers and expand their holdings.

Do what you can to reduce their numbers. Keep dem distracted and occupied. I'll sneak ahead and look for Wa'kani and de other scouts.

passages.title: Fried Eggs
passages.text:
Dat should stall their progress a bit. I don't even want to imagine how many of dem would be on our doorstep if we hadn't stepped in here.

All we need now is a slab of bacon and some toast.

passages.title: Fried Eggs
passages.text:
De snakes are focused on two things: killin' and reproducin'. Dey took over dis part of de swamp, leaving nothing livin' in their path and layin' eggs all over de place!

Burn any of de eggs you come across. Careful, though. You get too close, dey can burst open, and you don't wanna be anywhere near dem when dat happens.

passages.title: Savagery Among the Ruins
passages.text: Good work! We don't need two enemies at our backs. Hopefully de little ones have fled far enough away dat they won't be swayed like their elders.

passages.title: Savagery Among the Ruins
passages.text:
De murlocs entrenched demselves in these old ruins. Dey are usually a tough, but cowardly sort. Dis batch is different. Probably gone mad--don't know why, don't care.

Clear de ruins while you search. Don't slay their young, though. Dey don't seem to be affected by whatever got de others.

passages.title: Scouts in the Swamp
passages.text: Ndamu will be mourned. She protected Wa'kani to de end, as was her duty. I'm glad you and de others have returned safely.

passages.title: Scouts in the Swamp
passages.text:
I looked around some more while you were rescuin' Wa'kani. I think de other scouts were taken by de murlocs.

We'll have to search further into de ruins. I'll circle 'round and see if I can find anything. You're better than me in a fight, so you can search where I can't. Locate de scouts and meet me near de docks.

passages.title: Scouts in the Swamp
passages.text:
This was only supposed to be a recon mission...

Have you found de scouts?

passages.title: Special Assignment: Agents of the Shield
passages.text: WQ

passages.title: It Just Had to Be...
passages.text:
De snakes are scattered, and we still stand.

A small victory. But one I will take.

passages.title: It Just Had to Be...
passages.text:
Malacrass called these creatures the Children of Ula'tek.

Then it is so. My vision led Zul'jan to Ula'tek and from Ula'tek to Malacrass. Together, they must seek her.

I will do whatever is in my power to help, and make this right for Zul'jarra and her people.

Let us kill as many of these monsters as we can.

We will fight side by side and uproot this shared foe.

passages.title: It Just Had to Be...
passages.text: Just a few more and then on to Atal'Utek--and dealin' with Malacrass and my brother.

passages.title: Severing the Serpent's Head
passages.text: I'm gonna crush that mask.

passages.title: Severing the Serpent's Head
passages.text:
<Zul'jarra is covered in sweat, blood, and venom. Her face is grim in a way you haven't seen before.>

I need your help.

I ordered soldiers to move to a hut in de north as a lookout and to protect some Witherbark civilians trapped there.

But one of de monster brutes caught their scent. Kill it and rescue de civilians before dey end up like Dak'zor!

I will stay here and make sure none of these snakes get into de lodge.

passages.title: Drumming Up the Troops
passages.text:
Our warriors are here.

And with de loas' help, we will destroy these "Children of Ula'tek."

Now we gonna kill Malacrass himself!

passages.title: Drumming Up the Troops
passages.text:
De loa have blessed our battle!

Nalorakk and Halazzi are rippin' at their flanks. Akil'zon and Jan'alai are knockin' dem from de skies.

We will stay to de ground and push through de center--all of us--and rid Zul'Aman of these pests.

Sound de drums again, hash'ura. Call our warriors to de battle in Atal'Aman. Now we are united and dey will heed us!

passages.title: Trinket Trading
passages.text:
Interesting. Dey seem to be fetishes created by de snake creatures. Could dey be de source of de madness?

<Wa'kani cups one of the trinkets in her hands, concentrating. After a few moments, she sighs.>

Nothing. I sense no lingerin' magics. These trinkets are not de cause. I suspected as much.

passages.title: Trinket Trading
passages.text:
I've never seen murlocs dis vicious. A few of dem are holdin' something feathered dat glints green. Dat might be de source of de darkness I sense.

When you're out among de ruins, keep your eyes open for these objects. I think de murlocs unearthed somethin' dat's got them going mad.

passages.title: Trinket Trading
passages.text:
I know Zawadi thinks my presence here's a waste of time, even though we took down Ophidia. If I prove dat de murlocs have discovered something nefarious, she will have to admit I was right to come along.

These ruins are ancient. Who knows what might've sunk into de mire, only to be dug up by their greedy hands.

passages.title: The Shadow Shard
passages.text:
So de murloc chieftain had a shadow-filled crystal? I wonder...

It is possible dat de murlocs unearthed dis ancient relic and dat its power consumed dem. A pity it was destroyed. I would have liked to study it.

Ndamu is a great loss, but de work you did here today means her sacrifice was not in vain. De snakes have been dealt a solid blow, de murlocs should start calming down, and we destroyed de source of de dark energy. Thank you, <name>.

passages.title: The Shadow Shard
passages.text:
I thought de murlocs were driven into their frenzy by de trinkets, but they're just baubles made by de snakes. Once we drew closer to dat lighthouse, I began to suspect dey were not de cause.

I can feel it from here. A pulsing darkness. Ancient. If you go up there, you may find de true source of de murlocs' madness.

passages.title: The Shadow Shard
passages.text:
Your time was not wasted in gathering de trinkets. We were able to narrow down de source once we ruled them out!

That aside, I have never felt anything like de ripples of darkness coming from dat tower. Find and destroy whatever it is dat's controlling de murlocs.

passages.title: Delver's Call: The Darkway
passages.text: Thank you for that, <name>. Such magic is not for their kind.

passages.title: Delver's Call: The Darkway
passages.text:
Remnants of the Twilight's Blade scurry like rats through the Arcway tunnels beneath Suramar.

Exterminate the vermin before they spread.

passages.title: Delver's Call: Parhelion Plaza
passages.text: Perhaps one day Silvermoon will know peace again.

passages.title: Delver's Call: Parhelion Plaza
passages.text: Adventurers! Quel'Danas is once more under attack by the Void, and any who are able to provide assistance should head to the battlements of Parhelion Plaza to help stem the tide.

passages.title: Delver's Call: Parhelion Plaza
passages.text: The Void is relentless. Be cautious.

passages.title: Dealing with Pests
passages.text:
At this point, it's a game.

I know he's there. He knows I know he's there, but if I keep pretendin' I don't see him, I win dis round!

I wouldn't hate it if you helped him, though. Then we both win. Don't you tell him I said it.

passages.title: Dealing with Pests
passages.text:
Every time I leave my hut, I return to a mess and soggy little murloc footprints.

I am plannin' a different approach to deal with those pestersome amphibian encroachers, but I need to sort out some ingredients.

While I work out my list for those pests--there is a ghost named Jelvik dat keeps after me for somethin'. Tell him to move along.

passages.title: Dealing with Pests
passages.text: What do you mean you don't see a ghost?

passages.title: Unusual Alchemy
passages.text:
You're a useful creature!

I have ghosts dat harass me and murlocs makin' a mess every time I leave my hut. If de pests were not pesterin', dey wouldn't be pests, would dey?

I can tell--you're gonna be de one to solve my problem.

passages.title: Unusual Alchemy
passages.text:
My list is ready. I need you to gather de ingredients to keep dem murlocs away for good.

First, talk to Maka de Trawler. He and de kelpweaver from Torga's Beak like to catch fish in de inlet. Bring me some fish guts--disgustin' and perfect.

Next, head out to Mlurkkr Mire. I need dat dirty ol' pearl dey think is so special.

While you're in de Mire, relieve some of dem irritatin' serpent folk of some scales.

Mind you, I only want de good ones.

passages.title: Unusual Alchemy
passages.text: Did you bring de goods?

passages.title: Rocksblood
passages.text:
These pieces are comin' together... I almost have it. Get back to Ofi. I need to ponder dis for a bit.

I feel hope again, <class>. You did dis, and I give you my gratitude.

passages.title: Rocksblood
passages.text:
I've been here so long dat pieces of my memory are lost to time. I feel an emptiness for something I loved.

There will be no rest for me until I know who or what it was. I can only remember one word... Rocksblood. I don't know who or what dat is.

Check de murloc ruins to de south. There's someone who can point you in de right direction.

Since Ofi is bein' stubborn, I need you to help me remember.

passages.title: Acceptable Apprentice
passages.text:
Oosha! Dat is potent. I did not know your strength.

At least there was no explosion dis time.

Not bad, <race>.

passages.title: Acceptable Apprentice
passages.text:
Dis part is gonna be fun.

I got de mixture started. It is already unpleasant, but now we will make it really vile.

When you feel mentally prepared to be a useful one again, let me know.

passages.title: Acceptable Apprentice
passages.text: You feelin' challenged?

passages.title: Make it Stinky
passages.text:
Ha! Well done. Dat should keep dem runnin' for a while.

I do love de smell of chaos in de morning. 

Of course, it could also be you. Could you stand back a ways?

passages.title: Make it Stinky
passages.text:
Best you move our little deterrents out to de strip of land between my home and de maniacs' mire.

They may try to stop you, but hold fast. If it works, dey will be running with their tails between their legs.

Do murlocs even have tails?

passages.title: Make it Stinky
passages.text: Have de murlocs moved on?

passages.title: Recovering Memories
passages.text:
I may weep from de joy dat has filled my spirit. I thought she was gone so long ago dat even she eventually moved on from my mind.

Now my sweet Sava will be with me forever.

Thank you, <name>.

passages.title: Recovering Memories
passages.text:
To de northeast, there's a small island. I remember long ago a great roarin' and howlin' dat echoed across de waters.

I could hear de anger, but there was also pain. I could not venture to dat place. What if I became lost, my own feelings swallowed by de bigger ones?

One day, it became quiet again, but now I feel dis is de final key to de lock on my soul.

Go there. Find de last piece.

passages.title: Recovering Memories
passages.text: Did you find it?

passages.title: A Little Kindness
passages.text:
Now our game is over. I'm guessin' it's gonna be quieter around here with my friend gone.

What? I'm always pretendin' my friends don't exist. Who are you? Ha!

Ah, it looks like one of de small ones preferred your company to dat of de beast. You best take him with you.

passages.title: A Little Kindness
passages.text:
You know, my friend, as happy as I am... I keep thinkin' how sad we made dat beast. I do not wish dat feelin' on another livin' soul.

He took care of dear Sava for all de years she was lost. Could you help us with one last request?

If you could bring him a friend of his own, it will repay our debt.

Then we can move on once and for all--me and Sava will be free.

passages.title: A Little Kindness
passages.text:
Don't you tell anyone about my part in all of dat. 

If folks start thinkin' I'm soft, they'll never leave me alone.

passages.title: Bursting at the Seams
passages.text:
I've been focusing on my own feelings so much that I never stopped to think about how Veraan might feel.

I may not have fared any better had they pumped ME full of Void.

passages.title: Bursting at the Seams
passages.text:
Veraan... alive...

<Kifaan shakes his head in disbelief.>

I've spent countless hours running this moment through my head, but now that it's here, I find myself grasping for words...

The Shadowguard attempted to raise Dimensius to power... they've sworn fealty to Xal'atath as she wages war on worlds. Am I supposed to just... pretend none of that happened? Is THAT what my oaths to family require?

And what of Veraan? Does she regret her involvement?

I should check on her.

passages.title: TO DEPRECATE Battle for Zul'jarra
TO DEPRECATE Bloody Mercy
passages.text:
Has Zul'jan really thrown in his lot with these snakes? I don't understand what possible reason he'd join with these monsters. What promises did they make him?

Zul'jan will face retribution in time. But first, these so-called Children of Ula'tek will. We'll carve a swath through them to the temple, together.

passages.title: The Vaults of Atal'Utek: Altar of Fangs
passages.text:
I feel a chill from within ever since we retrieved the dagger.

Let's examine it, quickly.

passages.title: The Vaults of Atal'Utek: Altar of Fangs
passages.text:
Orweyna told us what she saw...

Damn it, Zul'jan! Does he truly not understand what he's done? Despite what we have accomplished, he sees the bonds Zul'jarra forged with the both of us as weakness and chases this idea of a "supreme Amani Empire" still.

And in the process, he has gravely wounded his sister.

But maybe Zul'jarra is right--maybe he doesn't know.

We have to get that dagger. By making him see sense, or by force.

passages.title: The Venomous Abyss
passages.text:
I saw things in de venom haze.

Heard Zul'jan screamin', felt what's eatin' away at him. 

Heard Malacrass whisperin' in his ear.

Ula'tek has haunted de Amani from de beginning. De lengths we went to for power and empire, and de blood it cost...

Dat wasn't greatness. Deep down, Zul'jan knows it too.

Malacrass stole my grandfather from me. I won't let him take Zul'jan too.

passages.title: Nature of Her Wounds
passages.text:
<name>... thank you. I saw so much. 

It's too late... No!

We must find my brother.

passages.title: Nature of Her Wounds
passages.text:
The Fang is cursed from the summoning of Ula'tek. We can use it to cure Zul'jarra. I just--

We have to act fast. She's fading!

passages.title: Lor'themar's Judgement
passages.text:
We need to tell Lor'themar what happened here. Meet me in Silvermoon.

As for Zul'jarra... she needs time. She needs her people, and her people need her.

She will survive this. I am sure of it. She must!

passages.title: Sparks of War: Eversong Woods
passages.text: That provides some answers, many thanks.

passages.title: Sparks of War: Eversong Woods
passages.text:
Mysterious creatures are out in the wild across the Eversong Woods. 

Go and see what you can find out about them.

passages.title: Sparks of War: Eversong Woods
passages.text: There's still more to do.

passages.title: Sparks of War: Zul'Aman
passages.text: Many thanks for clearing things out.

passages.title: Sparks of War: Zul'Aman
passages.text:
There's unknown danger out in Zul'Aman.

Get out there and clear things up!

passages.title: Sparks of War: Zul'Aman
passages.text: Well, get on then!

passages.title: Sparks of War: Harandar
passages.text: That was a tremdenous effort - much thanks.

passages.title: Sparks of War: Harandar
passages.text: Powerful creatures have grown through the lands across Harandar. Go look into it.

passages.title: Sparks of War: Harandar
passages.text: There's more to explore.

passages.title: Sparks of War: Voidstorm
passages.text: This provides some answers and clarity.

passages.title: Sparks of War: Voidstorm
passages.text: Chaotic forces are being disruptive in the Voidstorm. Go investigate and clear things up!

passages.title: Sparks of War: Voidstorm
passages.text: There's more to look out for.

passages.title: Trouble in the Swamp
passages.text: Ra'kamu sent you? Good. I could use de help.

passages.title: Trouble in the Swamp
passages.text:
A group of my people went over to Mlurkkr Mire and have not returned. Dey were looking into an incursion of de Children of Ula'tek in de region. There are also troubling reports of de local murlocs actin' more violent than usual, and de priest Wa'kani said she detected a strong dark energy she wanted to check out.

Their leader, Zawadi, was due to report back an hour ago. Will you go find dem and lend aid if needed?

passages.title: Retrieved Crumpled Present
passages.text:
<It seems the minions of the Greench have fled, leaving behind a small mangled, but still salvageable present.

Perhaps one of the Winter Festivities planners would be able to help return it to the original intended recipient.>

passages.title: A Grave Concern
passages.text:
Excellent. Feel free to make new arrangements whenever you would like.

I, like death, am a patient man.

passages.title: A Grave Concern
passages.text:
Dearly Departed,

Having just tasted the bitter sting of mortality, there seems no better time to discuss with you the oft ignored subject of death and memorialization. Of what you leave behind in a real, physical sense.

Leave discussion of love and other such frivolities to the philosophers and dandies. I speak of cold, hard stone and the deeds carved upon it.

Find me in Silvermoon.

passages.title: A Grave Concern
passages.text: Have you made your selection?

passages.title: Words to Hear
passages.text:
Never have the haranir's visions caused so much pain...

But knowledge in the wrong hands can be used for good or for ill.

passages.title: Words to Hear
passages.text:
Malacrass helped my grandfather lead de Amani to ruin. Now he's gonna do de same to my brother. If we could just separate de two of them... 

But Jan won't listen.

He thinks Ula'tek is a weapon dat will bring de return of de Amani Empire. After de vision he saw--and who knows what else Malacrass told him--I can't convince him otherwise.

De hash'ey requires counsel, my hash'ura. Gather de others and join me.

passages.title: A Soaring Journey Through Time
passages.text:
<name>, you've returned.

What tales do you bring?

passages.title: A Soaring Journey Through Time
passages.text:
The sands of time flow back and forth like ocean waves.

Journey once more through the timeways, to the time of Dragon Aspects and Primal Incarnates.

Bring me tales of victory in an era of great adventure and danger.

passages.title: A Soaring Path Through Time
passages.text: It's not every day one bears witness to the Dragon Aspects reforming. Cherish these moments.

passages.title: A Soaring Path Through Time
passages.text:
It was a time of forging new alliances and enemies. Reminisce with me about the great Dragon Aspects and their return to glory.

Venture back in time to the Dragon Isles and return with what knowledge you can.

passages.title: Enshrouded in Arenas
passages.text: Very impressive - you've earned these.

passages.title: Enshrouded in Arenas
passages.text: An important test to being a strong warrior is coordinating with others in combat. Find fellow combatants to join you in battle in the arena.

passages.title: The Season Starts: Midnight
passages.text: Good. Now as long as nothing goes wrong we can get to the good part.

passages.title: The Season Starts: Midnight
passages.text:
Things have started to get interesting, <name>. I'm hearing of all sorts of treasures popping up in delves.

I'm compiling my notes in this book, and our illustrious hosts have even broken out some of their own artifacts to trade for what we uncover.

Why don't you take a look before we head out. Better prepared than dead.

passages.title: The Season Starts: Midnight
passages.text: Ready to get going?

passages.title: Enshrouded Solo
passages.text: Great work, soldier. Take these.

passages.title: Enshrouded Solo
passages.text: Independence is key to excel in battle. Display your solo capabilities in then come back to me.

passages.title: Enshrouded in Teamwork
passages.text: Great work! You have earned these.

passages.title: Enshrouded in Teamwork
passages.text: The ability to work with a group to take objectives is key in training. Practice this on the battlefield.

passages.title: Enshrouded in Skirmishes
passages.text: Great practice! You've earned this!

passages.title: Enshrouded in Skirmishes
passages.text: Practice makers perfect. A great place to practice is with others like yourself looking to practice. Set off and find others like yourself to practice small-scale skirmishes, then return to me.

passages.title: Enshrouded in War
passages.text: Great effort.. Here, take this.

passages.title: Enshrouded in War
passages.text: Large conflicts get you to take a look at the larger picture. Give it a try then come back to me.

passages.title: Enshrouded in Battle
passages.text: It pays off to have an open mind! Take this for your time.

passages.title: Enshrouded in Battle
passages.text: You can learn a lot on the battlefield on your own. Go ahead and see what you observe.

passages.title: Enshrouded in Battle
passages.text: There's still more to explore.

passages.title: A Missing Member
passages.text: Kidnapping a murloc? For shame.

passages.title: A Missing Member
passages.text:
He took him! Finley...big...purple...man!

<Reno is clearly distraught and both physically and emotionally exhausted.>

passages.title: A Missing Member
passages.text: He looks devastated.

passages.title: Midnight Delves!
passages.text: We've got a lot to discuss.

passages.title: Midnight Delves!
passages.text:
Things are starting to get interesting in Delves.

Come see me in Silvermoon.

passages.title: Nulling Nullaeus
passages.text:
Thanks for the assist.

I've been where Finley was.

passages.title: Nulling Nullaeus
passages.text:
That thing looked tough, and it took Reno out as an afterthought.

We'll want the best gear we can get before trying to take it down.

Thankfully, I have some leads on bountiful delves we can start with.

passages.title: Nulling Nullaeus
passages.text: He'll get what's coming to him.

passages.title: The Search for Wa'kani
passages.text: Thank you for freein' me. We can't leave yet, though. I found de source of all these eggs!

passages.title: The Search for Wa'kani
passages.text:
While you were keepin' de snakes busy, I was lookin' for Wa'kani and de other scouts. De scouts are still missin', but Wa'kani is in dat temple over there.

I tried gettin' closer, but it's too heavily guarded. You should have no problem, though. Please rescue my fool sista before de snakes do something foul to her.

passages.title: Against Overwhelming Odds
Against Overwhelming Odds
Conditional - Multiple Objectives, Non Sequenced
passages.text:
I be sent out here ta prove dat I can be an amani warrior.

Dis trial needs me ta collect as many trophies from dese gnarldin as possible. 

De two of us should work together! I be helpin' you get recognized as an amani warrior, yeah?

Just go out dere and get as many trophies from de gnarldin as possible. 

I be stayin' behind ta watch our backs, eh?

passages.title: A Call to Battle
passages.text:
How did you fare in the battlegrounds? Some wins? Some losses?

There are lessons to be learned from both.

passages.title: A Call to Battle
passages.text:
Ours is a world of constant struggle, wouldn't you agree? Even in between times of peace, there is value in keeping one's battle skills sharpened.

I have heard much of your prowess. Let us see what you are capable of.

passages.title: A Call to Battle
passages.text: There is no substitute for constant vigilance, <class>. Al'anna, dalomore.

passages.title: A Call to Delves
passages.text: You yet live, which means two things. The first is that I was correct in guiding you to those delves. The second is that you are more capable than you were before.

passages.title: A Call to Delves
passages.text:
Seeking out challenge and treasure can test one's skills, all while uncovering that which will give us even greater power.

Were I you, I would delve into places that provide both.

passages.title: A Call to Delves
passages.text: Has your delving come to a satisfactory conclusion?

passages.title: Emissary of War
passages.text: You have proven yourself beyond even my wildest expectations. Well done, <name>.

passages.title: Emissary of War
passages.text:
It is only when we push ourselves beyond our limits that we truly grow... or fail and make way for others.

Prove yourself by challenging the deadliest of places. Shorel'aran.

passages.title: Emissary of War
passages.text: Will you become the stuff of myths and legends, <class>?

passages.title: The Very Best
passages.text: News of your success precedes you. You guided your team well, <name>.

passages.title: The Very Best
passages.text:
Even the smallest amongst us must play their part. That includes our little friends.

If you would strengthen both their prowess and your bond, challenge others. Only the fittest will survive.

passages.title: The Very Best
passages.text: By strengthening those bonds, you and your little companions will be ready for whatever comes.

passages.title: The Arena Calls
passages.text: Impressive. But remember, a champion only remains so as long as they continue to win.

passages.title: The Arena Calls
passages.text:
Old, musty dungeons and battlefields are one thing, but the arena is where the wheat and the chaff are separated.

Can you prove yourself, <class>? Show me. Let me hear your name shouted from the stands by those crying for blood.

passages.title: The World Awaits
passages.text: Your efforts are known and appreciated. Anu bala belore'alon.

passages.title: The World Awaits
passages.text:
Sinu a'manore, <class>. It is true in the past, I have been less than... egalitarian in my outlook. Yet in these times of trouble, there is much to be done--whether here in Quel'Thalas or elsewhere.

Will you face the challenge and prove yourself once more?

passages.title: The World Awaits
passages.text:
Trouble is everywhere. We are measured by how we overcome these obstacles.

Will it be with grace or fury? Perhaps a bit of both?

passages.title: An Original Path Through Time
passages.text:
Be sure to share anything you may have learned from the past so that we do not make the same mistakes in the future.

Al diel shala, <name>.

passages.title: An Original Path Through Time
passages.text:
Greetings, <class>. You come to me because you seek answers. I have nothing for you but guidance.

Perhaps the answers you seek lie in the past? Return to that time mere years after the conclusion of the Third War. Face its threats once again and see what wisdom you can glean.

passages.title: A Burning Path Through Time
passages.text:
The elves of Quel'Thalas suffered much during that period of time--but learned more truths and lessons than can be truly counted. 

No doubt you are stronger and wiser for the journey you have taken.

passages.title: A Burning Path Through Time
passages.text:
On the other side of the Dark Portal lies Outland. I've never been--my history is tied to the Kirin Tor rather than Silvermoon. Yet the elves of Quel'Thalas went through much turmoil during that period of time. 

Perhaps you could learn a thing or two from that fractured world. Take up the challenge, if you feel worthy of it.

passages.title: A Shattered Path Through Time
passages.text: You have more courage than I, champion. Let us hope any lessons you have learned will be carried forward in earnest.

passages.title: A Shattered Path Through Time
passages.text:
The Cataclysm was terrifying for all of Azeroth. The existential threat of Deathwing echoes down through the ages. Isn't it interesting that no matter how things change, such threats return time and time again, but in different forms?

Go back and face those threats again. See if there's something new to learn from the past.

passages.title: A Shattered Path Through Time
passages.text: I... would not relive those times. Some memories are best left behind.

passages.title: A Shrouded Path Through Time
passages.text: Have you returned enlightened or embittered by the decisions of the past? I hope your lessons were easier to learn than my own.

passages.title: A Shrouded Path Through Time
passages.text:
My memories of Pandaria are... complicated, <class>. Many lessons were learned during that tumultuous period of time--some good, some painful. 

The world has changed a great deal since then. We've all changed--I hope for the better.

Travel back through the mists of time. Relearn what lessons you can.

passages.title: A Savage Path Through Time
passages.text: Well done, <class>. It's intriguing to consider what might have been, and view the splintering of history with one's own eyes. I hope it was an illuminating journey.

passages.title: A Savage Path Through Time
passages.text:
Perhaps you can untangle the depth of knowledge to be found in Draenor--not the shattered remains of Outland, but the Draenor of the Iron Horde. It is, in its own ways, just as harsh if not harsher than Outland ever was. 

See what wisdom you can find there.

passages.title: A Fel Path Through Time
passages.text: You do indeed still have what it takes. May the Legion never return.

passages.title: A Fel Path Through Time
passages.text:
I have faced many enemies, but the Burning Legion was perhaps the greatest threat our world ever faced. At least... until now.

Of course, there are our inner demons to contend with as well.

Do you still have what it takes to defeat the Burning Legion?

passages.title: A Scarred Path Through Time
passages.text: Returned at last--with victory under your belt, or perhaps deeper lessons learned than what can be found in the throes of battle?

passages.title: A Scarred Path Through Time
passages.text:
I remember well the battles of the Alliance and Horde that played out in Kul Tiras and Zandalar. Return there, relive the memories. 

Will you seek glory, or knowledge? Or perhaps both?

passages.title: A Shadowed Path Through Time
passages.text: To stride boldly into the lands of the afterlife and come out the other side... a Maw Walker indeed, every inch of you.

passages.title: A Shadowed Path Through Time
passages.text:
Would you return to the realm of death and risk your very existence? Rebirth, eternal peace, endless torment? All can be found across the veil. 

Travel to the Shadowlands once more. If you can defeat its most dangerous places, perhaps you will return to the living wiser and more powerful.

passages.title: Fish Finagling
Against Overwhelming Odds
Against Overwhelming Odds
An Old Game for a New Age

passages.text:
<name>! Glad to see you. The defenders in the fortress could use your help.

One of the gnomes built a robot to try to help defend the keep. However, it goes haywire every time it turns on.

She needs the help of someone who can properly disrupt the robot's attacks so it can be repaired.

Do you have a moment to help?

passages.title: Alchemy Services Requested
passages.text: You have our gratitude, <class>. Silvermoon stands stronger thanks to your skills.

passages.title: Alchemy Services Requested
passages.text:
Welcome back, <class>. If you're still interested in working with the Artisan's Consortium, we would value your aid. We need highly skilled artisans to craft supplies for the war effort.

If your work meets Silvermoon's high standards of quality, please fill any public crafting orders you find on the board. You can also fill orders for yourself, your guildmates, or private patrons.

Bring back proof of completed orders and I'll see that you're adequately compensated.
